segments.name: Shopping Centers
segments.description: Owns and operates grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use assets leased to retail tenants in Sun Belt and gateway markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary business is the ownership and operation of high-quality, open-air shopping centers and mixed-use assets that are primarily grocery-anchored and located in high-growth Sun Belt markets and select strategic gateway markets in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay contractual rents and reimbursement payments under existing lease agreements at the company's shopping centers and mixed-use asset properties.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue primarily from the collection of contractual rents and reimbursement payments from tenants under existing lease agreements at each of our properties.
